result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** the screen is 1280px wide inside `#component`, on a white page with a centered 1120px column. The "Team" heading is on the left in Unbounded Light caps. The "Invite Member" ink pill button is on the right.
- **Members:** the five members are in one bordered card, in 52px rows with dividers. Each row has a bold name, a muted email and a 44px role select (Admin, Editor, Viewer) with the right role chosen.
- **Rules followed:** everything uses the tokens from `tokens.css`, with the needed ones copied into the file so it stands alone. There's no JavaScript.
- **Choices:**
  - I added no column headers, to keep the content exactly as you gave it.
  - The selects have `aria-label`s instead of visible labels.
  - No font files were available, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to the system sans-serif unless installed locally.
